skills.name: I... Didn't Lose...
skills.description: Facing forward, raises fist to the sky. Gives good effects to allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs (4 sec) *Skill Resistance +40% (8 sec)

skills.name: Brave Fist
skills.description: Hops forward while attacking with a wide sweeping punch. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3200% Area Damage  *Enemy Attack Range -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -40% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Tokyo Revengers 2
abilities.description: Tokyo Revengers 2 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 7 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
